title: pytest-bdd skill (agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd)
item: pytest-bdd skill — build it from the order-cancel example conversion
motivation: Converting specs by hand doesn't scale; the conversion also feeds findings back into agent-spec
notes: Build order: fake order system → grader primitives → scripted reference agent with broken variants → convert S01, S12, S20, S26, S41 → review findings → write the skill → convert the rest. Café hand-conversion is the reference.
source_chat: Pytest-bdd verification for agent-spec (Nov 1); Order-support agent login design (Nov 5–6)
done_means: The agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd skill turns a new-format spec's scenarios into feature files and steps without rewording. On the cafe example the reference agent passes every test and each broken variant fails at least one. A drift check fails when a scenario changes in the spec.
draft_note: Owner decided 2026-11-15: build on the cafe new-format spec first. No longer depends on 11 or 19: BDD tests gate with a scripted reference agent. S01, S12, S20, S26, S41 were old-format scenario IDs. Branch add-agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd holds earlier work, not reviewed.
